comparator.route: Ordinary non-abroad Linguistics programme; current 30 EC fixed-minor regime
comparator.sourceNotes: Exact Dutch full-time BA Taalwetenschap, CROHO56803/RIO1001O5997, Radboud Faculty of Arts. Adopted 2026–27 annual examination framework for the ordinary non-abroad programme with the post-September-2025 30 EC minor regime: B1 60 compulsory, B2 30 compulsory plus two fixed approved Faculty of Arts minors of15 EC, B3 30 compulsory plus30 broadening electives; total180 EC,120 compulsory/30restricted/30open. This is the currently adopted programme framework, not a guaranteed multi-year future entrant offering. No old40ECminor cohort or abroad substitution is stacked into it. Minor slots remain explicitly restricted choices under the published approved packages, rather than inventing six compulsory linguistics minor courses from an indicative2028–29 page. Free space excludes own-programme/specialisation courses and uses bachelor-level broadening; foreign credits require prior approval six working weeks before departure. Three zero-credit requirements are recorded separately: B1 mentoring/RADAr-NL and B2 mentoring/PPO. B3 professional development is10 EC including a supervised team think tank with societal partner, career/portfolio/reflection. Thesis10EC requires Data-analysis/inferential statistics (or oldLingLab1), Corpuslinguistics (or oldLingLab2), and LingLab3; current OER article7 explicitly replaces LingLab3 with Experimental Linguistics. This is an explicit transition rule, not an invented waiver. Experimental Linguistics assumes statistics/R at Research-design/descriptive-statistics level and involves speech-perception experiment, mixed-model regression and group report. Thesis restricted to BA Linguistics (premaster exception), registered inOsiris, signed thesis agreement before research, subject/supervisor agreed and regular supervision; independent linguistic question/data/method/analysis/report. SpeechVoiceHearing, if chosen in a minor, follows Phonetics. BSA normally45EC; late-entry rule60EC as general appendix states. Mentoring/active-participation courses have attendance requirement: more than35% absence in a period excludes further participation/exams unless exception. Practical exercises and sufficient component assessments apply as course manuals specify. RADAr is a first-year diagnostic assessment at0EC; no invented universal no-exemption/pass condition. Visible pages7–8 and10 and hidden metadata checked: specific OER11pages created/modified25June2026, all visible annual headings2026–27. Adopted B3 has Pragmatics and History ofDutch, not prospective2029–30 LanguageProficiency/LanguageNorms. Prospective B2 headings print30EC per supplementary minor despite prose3x5EC=15; general adopted article10 establishes two fixed15ECminors. Current annual restricted slots replace that prospective selection; selected-route claims no longer mix future offerings with current adopted requirements.

exception.reason: UCR offers genuine psycholinguistics, stylistics, rhetorical communication and text-related computing. The proposed programmes place most credits in broader cognition, media, communication or general computing and mathematics. They do not sustain the cumulative phonetic, phonological, morphological, syntactic, semantic, sociolinguistic and language-research study that defines this Linguistics degree. A broad coherent programme and a small number of direct language courses cannot establish a sufficiently close complete response. This finding concerns academic substance, not identical courses or professional equivalence.

exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Both original routes devote 15 EC to Psycholinguistics and Style & Meaning, genuine direct language study with different approaches. Primary: 37.5 EC communication/rhetoric/creative-language courses (including stylistics), 37.5 EC neuroscience, 30 EC psychology/statistics/meta-analysis/development, 15 EC sociology, 15 EC literature, 22.5 EC media, 7.5 EC philosophy, 7.5 EC data science and 7.5 EC PPD =180. The computational route has 127.5 EC computing/AI/data/mathematics, 37.5 EC brain/neurobiology/higher cognition/psycholinguistics/psychology methods, 7.5 EC stylistics and 7.5 EC PPD. Deep learning genuinely includes text classification/LLMs, but is broader than language. These partial strengths do not form a sustained descriptive/theoretical linguistic sequence or cumulative linguistic methods; general social theory is not sociolinguistics and signal processing is not speech science. Weighting is a substantive judgment, not a course-match quota.

candidateAssessment.label: Language, cognition & communication
candidateAssessment.reason: UCR offers genuine psycholinguistics, stylistics, rhetorical communication and text-related computing. The proposed programmes place most credits in broader cognition, media, communication or general computing and mathematics. They do not sustain the cumulative phonetic, phonological, morphological, syntactic, semantic, sociolinguistic and language-research study that defines this Linguistics degree. A broad coherent programme and a small number of direct language courses cannot establish a sufficiently close complete response. This finding concerns academic substance, not identical courses or professional equivalence.

candidateAssessment.label: Data, AI & language applications
candidateAssessment.reason: 127.5 EC general computing/AI/mathematics and only15 EC psycholinguistics/stylistics, plus partial text/LLM applications, do not sustain computational-linguistics or a sufficiently close programme-level linguistic response.

candidateAssessment.label: Language and health
candidateAssessment.reason: Psycholinguistics includes impairment but no sustained speech/voice/hearing, language-disorder assessment/intervention or language-development sequence. Generic neuroscience/development is insufficient.

candidateAssessment.label: Multilingualism and society
candidateAssessment.reason: Sociology and communication are meaningful context but no sustained sociolinguistics, multilingualism and language-variation sequence exists in actual workbook. No manufactured third route.

audience.programmeDescription: Radboud Linguistics investigates how languages are structured, acquired, processed and used. It connects language science with cognition, multilingual societies, health and technology, supported by statistics, corpus analysis, experiments and independent research.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers psycholinguistics, stylistic analysis, rhetoric and some text-based computing. These are useful connections, but the available courses do not build the sustained study of language structure and linguistic research at the centre of this degree. We therefore show Radboud’s curriculum without presenting a UCR programme as a sufficiently close alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The adopted annual framework totals 180 EC: 120 required, 30 in two fixed Faculty of Arts minors and 30 in broadening electives. Each minor is a complete approved 15 EC package. Free electives exclude courses from the student’s own programme or specialisation. The 10 EC thesis requires the preceding language-research sequence, registration and a signed supervision agreement. B3 professional development includes a team think tank and portfolio. First-year mentoring and the diagnostic RADAr-NL language assessment, and B2 mentoring, carry no credits. The usual first-year study-advice threshold is 45 EC. Current annual requirements do not guarantee future offerings.
